method: Read saved JSON/Python/NPZ only; reconstruct all98 configurations independently; compute every full cache oracle directly from before-cache, source rows and indices; compare all backings and actual launch records. No WSL/GPU execution.
source_review: Accepted grouped source hash5b190ce52e0f6c25f99b739346c2787f194ed7e75c759144cf25fcb06c8a1bd1; AST still matches exactly three demonstrated expressions; four warps and four grouped rows. Frozen v1/kernel/checker/contract and30 runners match pins;29 acceptance gate matches preserved evidence.
live_source_limit: Current Windows shared scripts were directly checked. WSL live learner sources were not accessed by this offline audit; their launch-time saved copies were verified against pins and accepted snapshots. Future timing must recheck live identity.
launch_review: All168 nonempty calls have one recorded KV submission. Frozen grid=B; grouped grid=ceil(B/4), BATCH=B and ROWS_PER_PROGRAM=4; both four warps. Actual strides/block/width match each saved tensor/configuration. All28 empty wrappers have zero submissions.
arrays: All196 complete caches match independently recomputed expectations including untouched rows and guard bytes; full input backing including gap and all indices unchanged. Both arms match each other for all98 configurations.
invalid_review: 18 distinct invalid kinds per arm; all36 reject with zero KV submissions and five visible argument views unchanged. This does not prove every hidden backing byte remained unchanged for invalid calls.
scope: C32, FP16/int32, B0/1/2/3/4/5/17, D64/128/192, selected14 layout/input-gap/cache-guard combinations across seven batch sizes.
failure_review: Top-level PASS/current_case=null; no error/error_type/error.txt; all expected case/pair/rejection records present.
ownership: Coach demonstrated grouped row/mask/grid expressions; learner applied and executed them. No independent authorship or mastery inferred.
limitations: Full refers only to the defined98-configuration common matrix, not arbitrary layouts/values/shapes.
No B16/B256 or C1024 in this correctness run; six-case timing inputs must each pass actual-input checks.
Empty cases are public-wrapper returns, not GPU B0 execution.
No timing, speedup, hardware counters, model or AMD results; array checks do not prove absence of every invalid read.
